segments.text: A queue stores tasks in the order they arrive. The oldest task is normally processed first.
A worker takes a task from the queue and processes it. More workers can help handle more tasks, but completion order may differ.
If a worker fails, the task may be retried. Design the operation so repeating it does not accidentally duplicate the result.
A queue helps absorb a burst of work. It does not remove the need for enough processing capacity over time.
